Rajya Sabha Adjourned Amid Uproar Over Alleged 'Lungi Wala' Remark

The Rajya Sabha was adjourned until 2 pm following an uproar triggered by a remark allegedly made by BJP MP Sushmita Dev against CPI(M) MP John Brittas. Brittas stated that Dev called him "lungi wala" during a debate. The opposition protested the alleged derogatory remark, leading to disruptions in Question Hour. The Chair called for respect for regional identities and summoned members for discussions. A privilege notice was filed in relation to the incident.
